rows.organisme: Council of Architecture
rows.notes: Architects Act 1972: protects the title “architect” (not practice as such). Headcount = the COA’s “State-wise” table, current as at 5 August 2026 (verified on that date); Maharashtra 38,984, Tamil Nadu 15,993. Online directory verified: search by name/number/state, BUT limited to 3 searches per day per IP address, with unlimited access chargeable — no bulk download.

rows.organisme: Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners
rows.notes: PCATP Ordinance of 1983; registration compulsory in order to practise. Nominal list in PDF (electoral roll of architects in good standing, 4,592 names as at 6 February 2023) plus searchable pages. PITFALL: the TLS certificate of pcatp.org.pk has expired (observed on 5 August 2026); the 2023 list is a roll of electors (members in good standing), and the cumulative registered headcount is higher. IAP = UIA section. Reclassified on 5 August 2026 (direct count, zero discrepancy — “Total = 4592” printed on every page): an ELECTORAL roll of voters, hence a LOWER bound on the register (registration numbers running up to A08934, with massive gaps); breakdown: Punjab 2,012, Sindh 1,272, Islamabad 565, KP 509, Balochistan 137, Abroad 61, AJK 17, GB 17, FATA 2.

rows.organisme: Institute of Architects Bangladesh
rows.notes: VERIFIED: there is no statutory council and no Architects Act in Bangladesh — the IAB (1972) is an association. In practice, the drawings submitted for permits (RAJUK/BNBC) must be signed by an IAB member, which makes it the de facto register. “More than 5,000” members (order of magnitude, undated).

rows.organisme: Architects Registration Board (under the SLIA Act)
rows.notes: The ARB was created by Amendment Act no. 14 of 1996 (SLIA Act 1976); annual registration compulsory in 3 categories (Chartered Architects, Architects, Architectural Licentiates); annual publication in an Extraordinary Gazette. VERIFIED: arb.lk publishes 3 nominal Google Sheets (names, addresses, qualifications, numbers, contact details) that can be exported — the “Chartered” sheet was opened successfully; the headcount has to be counted from the sheets (no aggregate is published). slia.lk blocks robots (403) but is live.

rows.organisme: Nepal Engineering Council
rows.notes: No architects’ council — an “architects among engineers” regime: the NEC (Act of 1999, licensing by examination since 2022, 37 disciplines) also registers architects, and registration is required in order to sign drawings. The architecture headcount is not published. PITFALL: register.nec.gov.np is the examination enrolment portal, not a searchable register. SONA (UIA section) ~1,900 members; it is campaigning for a future Architects’ Council.

rows.organisme: Bhutan Construction and Transport Authority (formerly the Construction Development Board)
rows.notes: Registration of architects (Bhutanese citizens, certificate valid for 2 years) inherited from the CDB and taken over by the BCTA — bcta.gov.bt is live and points to citizenservices.gov.bt/cdb. PITFALLS: cdb.gov.bt no longer resolves; citizenservices.gov.bt presents a TLS certificate that is invalid to robots. A Bhutan Institute of Architects (BIA) is mentioned, with no verifiable online presence.

rows.organisme: Ministry of Infrastructure, Housing and Urban Development (registers of construction industry practitioners)
rows.notes: Construction Industry Practitioners Regulation (2019/R-1010): licensing on qualifications, applications through oneGov. The ministry publishes 12 registers online, among them the “Building Designers Registry” (index page confirmed). PITFALL: architects appear there under “building designers”.

rows.organisme: No functioning statutory system identified
rows.notes: No professional order and no state register identified; associations only (AEC; SAE, founded 1993, diaspora; AEA Kabul 2008). Post-2021 context: no reliable public data — nothing is to be extrapolated.

rows.organisme: Organisation of the Construction Engineering System (نظام مهندسی ساختمان)
rows.notes: Act of 1995; architecture is one of the 7 registered disciplines, with a practising licence (پروانه اشتغال); 31 provincial organisations. All-disciplines headcount ~500,000 (Tehran statement, 2018, verified); ~600,000 announced in December 2025 (press, not verified against a primary source). The ARCHITECTS headcount has never been published separately. Searching is done through the provincial organisations (e.g. tceo.ir); the national sites are unstable.

rows.organisme: Iraqi Engineers Union (نقابة المهندسين العراقية)
rows.notes: Law 62 of 1959; membership and grading compulsory in order to practise, architecture included. ieu-iq.org verified: no headcount and no public directory. PITFALL: Iraqi Kurdistan has its own union, not covered by the IEU — national counts are therefore partial.

rows.organisme: Syndicate of Syrian Engineers (نقابة المهندسين السوريين)
rows.notes: A single syndicate covering all disciplines, architecture included; the historic UIA section is the “Order of Syrian Engineers and Architects”. ~300,000 engineers across all disciplines (SANA, 1 April 2026, verified); the architects’ share is not published. The institutions are being reconstituted post-2024 — every figure is provisional; engsyn.org no longer resolves.

rows.organisme: Ordre des ingénieurs et architectes (Beirut and Tripoli)
rows.notes: Act of 1951: TWO separate orders — Beirut (oea.org.lb, the whole country except the North) and Tripoli (oea-tripoli.org.lb); membership compulsory, architects registered together with the engineers. Beirut: >50,000 members across all disciplines (LSE 2024); the architects’ headcount is not published. oea.org.lb blocks robots (403); any “Lebanon” statistic must add Beirut + Tripoli together.

rows.organisme: Jordan Engineers Association (نقابة المهندسين الأردنيين)
rows.notes: Founded 1948/49, membership compulsory; the architects form the “Architectural Engineering Division”. Total across all disciplines >170,000 (2020). The architects’ headcount is not published; jea.org.jo is live but the English page of the architecture division is empty — the data live on the Arabic side; no public directory found.

rows.organisme: Engineers Association – Jerusalem Center (نقابة المهندسين – مركز القدس)
rows.notes: An all-disciplines syndicate (architecture included), with Jerusalem/West Bank branches; a separate association in Gaza. ~24,000 members across all disciplines at the end of 2017; the architects’ share is not published. paleng.org publishes databases of FIRMS (2024-2026), not a directory of individuals. The UIA section is the “Association of Architects of Palestine”, separate from the syndicate.

rows.organisme: Registrar of Engineers and Architects (Ministry of Labour) — the engineers and architects pinkas
rows.notes: Engineers and Architects Law 5718-1958: entry in the pinkas plus a licence for reserved acts; protected title. Public querying through data.labor.gov.il/EngineersAndArchitects.aspx. PITFALL: gov.il blocks robots (403) — the URLs are valid in a browser; no aggregate headcount is published; nothing on data.gov.il. IAUA = UIA section.

rows.organisme: Saudi Council of Engineers (هيئة المهندسين السعودية)
rows.notes: SCE registration compulsory; architecture is a branch of the engineers’ council; licensing through Mumaris Plus. Architecture headcount: 14,279 = 2,314 Saudis + 11,965 expatriates (SCE report via Arab News, 2014, verified — DATED FIGURE, the SCE total at the time being ~144,000); >300,000 engineers claimed recently (not verified). saudieng.sa blocks fetches; checking Mumaris requires an account. UIA section = Saudi Umran Society.

rows.organisme: Society of Engineers – UAE + professional licensing emirate by emirate (Dubai Municipality, DMT/TAMM Abu Dhabi)
rows.notes: NO single national register: SOE membership plus a licence in each emirate (Dubai Municipality examination, the TAMM portal in Abu Dhabi, and so on). Architects follow the engineers’ route (“architectural engineer”). No headcount published; soeuae.ae unreachable. Counting the architects of the UAE would require aggregating 7 separate regimes.

rows.organisme: Engineers’ accreditation committee of the Ministry of Municipality (known as UPDA/MMUP)
rows.notes: Law no. 19 of 2005: compulsory registration (examination plus interview, with grades); architecture treated as an engineering speciality (the “UPDA Architecture” examination). NAMING PITFALL: the UPDA no longer exists as an authority — the acronym survives for the ministry’s committee. No public list and no headcount can be verified.

rows.organisme: Kuwait Society of Engineers (جمعية المهندسين الكويتية)
rows.notes: Society founded in 1962; a de facto compulsory step (the Public Authority of Manpower requires the KSE NOC/membership for visas and for practice, architects included). Strict accreditation of degrees. kseonline.org verified, with no public directory and no statistics.

rows.organisme: Council for Regulating the Practice of Engineering Professions
rows.notes: Law no. 51 of 2014: individual licence compulsory, architecture = a regulated engineering profession. crpep.bh is live; public list of licensed FIRMS (blocked to robots, 403); a list of INDIVIDUALS is not confirmed. No headcount published.

rows.organisme: Oman Society of Engineers
rows.notes: The OSE was founded in 2001; since February 2023 the Ministry of Labour has required OSE classification of all engineers, with a “Professional Architect” category; the licensing of firms (MoCIIP) requires the OSE certificate. The system is reachable only through a log-in portal — no public register; no headcount published.

rows.organisme: Syndicate of Yemeni Engineers (نقابة المهندسين اليمنيين)
rows.notes: An all-specialities syndicate, architecture included; no reliable official website (a social-media presence only). A “Yemeni Architects Society” (Sana’a, 2008) exists, with no verifiable website. The country is de facto split and its institutions duplicated — no headcount can be inferred.
